{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for loyal customers only
df_loyal = df_clean[df_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute conversion fraction directly
conversion_fraction = df_loyal['converted'].mean()

# Explicitly print the value as a float to ensure it is captured in evidence
print(conversion_fraction)"}
